name: OKR Objective Progress
query: select o.name, o.objective_title, o.cycle, o.company, o.department, o.owner_user, o.progress, o.confidence, o.status, count(k.name) as key_result_count from `tabOKR Objective` o left join `tabOKR Key Result` k on k.objective = o.name group by o.name, o.objective_title, o.cycle, o.company, o.department, o.owner_user, o.progress, o.confidence, o.status order by o.modified desc
